lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with highest density concentrated in the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with circular spot nodes to form a lattice-like grid across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature extending across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin displays irregular luminance patches and potential structural fraying.
other_distinctive_markers: Human snorkeler is visible in the upper-right background quadrant, partially out of focus.
